findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 337 requests to 96 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 4.3 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.1 MB (71%) came from third-party domains, 1.7 MB of it from services classified as tracking (254 requests).

65 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
164 cookies were set by third-party domains (212 cookies in total).
